'''February 2001 East Lansing tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fortress, East Lansing, Michigan on 13 February 2001. [[Andrew Ehret]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1730">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-east-lansing-michigan-feb-132001d1730/ east-lansing-michigan-feb-132001], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 13 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-east-lansing-michigan-feb-132001d1730/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Fortress, East Lansing, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Ehret]]
